knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says wet cloths and mop heads go in a separate bag so water does not reach products or documents. On top of product containers (option 0) and in the passenger cabin (option 2) are both ruled out.

The lesson says to contain the leak as the SDS directs, ventilate the vehicle if safe and report it. Continuing to drive (option 0) and returning the contaminated cloth to the kit (option 2) are named as wrong.
The dangerous goods section says to check the product's classification and the limits before transporting any larger quantity.

practicalCriteria: Learner separates a supplied set of kit items by class and contains each class during transport, with products sealed, labelled and upright.
Learner secures a supplied load with straps, racks or lockable boxes before driving.
Learner checks a supplied set of containers for leaks and states the containment step the SDS directs for a simulated leak.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Daily vehicle check record for leaks and load security
Leak or spill record with product, quantity and action taken
stopWorkCriteria: Learner carries chemicals in the passenger cabin or next to food or drink
Learner transports a larger quantity of product before confirming its dangerous goods position
Learner keeps driving with a leaking container
